title: Passata Chilli Con Carne
ingredients: 1 small red birdseye chilli, seeded, finely chopped
400g can red kidney beans, drained, rinsed
Cooked SunRice Brown Medium Grain Rice and tortillas, to serve
method: Heat oil in a casserole dish over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 2-3 minutes until it softens. Add garlic, chilli powder, chilli, cumin and cinnamon. Cook for 1 minute, stirring. Add mince and cook, breaking up the lumps, for 8-10 minutes until browned.
Add tomato puree, passata and wine. Season and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 40 minutes. Add beans and cook uncovered for 10-15 minutes.
Serve with rice and warm tortillas.
